glossEn: be identical or equivalent to / be equal to in quality or ability
note: be identical or equivalent to / be equal to in quality or ability。**高频动词义，但现有中文完全没有**。线索：equal to / three equal parts。两条边界只差「数值」与「能力」，合并。

glossEn: make equal, uniform, corresponding, or matching
note: make equal, uniform, corresponding, or matching。及物动词。线索：equalize / equal the shares。现有中文无对应，属新增。

glossEn: having the same quantity, value, or measure as another
note: having the same quantity, value, or measure as another。线索：equal weight / equal treatment。**注意拼写**：equal（相等的）vs equally（同样地）vs equality（平等）。
